newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to issue other bonds before end March.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to issue other bonds before end March.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez, confirming the issue of a $2 billion global bond, said the nation will also issue $1 billion in other bonds before March 30.
He told reporters the size of each tranche of the global bullet bond issue, to have maturities of five and 20 years, was still undecided.
JP Morgan and Merrill Lynch will be lead underwriters of the $2 billion global issue that will take place in the second half of January, Fernandez said.
Ministry officials will conduct a roadshow from Jan 13-21 in Europe, the United States and Asia to promote the bonds.
The Argentine government has budgeted $8 billion worth of new debt issues this year.
Fernandez said most of the financing approved for 1997 will have been raised following the two issues announced Tuesday and bonds worth $2 billion issued in December 1996 for 1997 spending needs.
